scope: POSTHOC prompt-format development on SAME8 authored stencil tasks, after observing partial original outputs. Not independent transfer, external held-out, or model-only/frontier evidence. Original cohort retained unchanged.
policy: All16 follow-up conditions frozen before ANY follow-up generation. Same16 paired jobs/order/model/sampler/nonthinking512token cap/grammar/compiler/tests. Identical revised prompt in both arms: correct32-normal-plus-up-to7-closure wording, empty-stack explanation, ONE generic constant-only worked example. No task-answer example, hidden-test feedback, retries or seed search. All original generations must finish first.

preconditions: distinct input/output storage
original serial accesses are in bounds
Float32 output and Float32/Int32 input vectors, Int/Int32 scalars, ordinary Base arithmetic bindings
one-dimensional launch with unique one-based global x IDs, covering 1:N
certificate.guarantee: under these preconditions, each valid invocation executes exactly one original iteration and writes only its unique output index; no claim about whether the original arithmetic solves the task
certificate.additional_admission: integer-only loop bound, native-Int induction for 1:N, no shadowed runtime/math bindings
certificate.interface: Pure finite postfix program over ONE Float32 input vector
certificate.arithmetic_policy: Exactly the model-selected actions in order; no task matching, arithmetic repair, hidden-answer lookup, or unconstrained Julia evaluation
